item.text: {"search_note":"I searched for 2024 evidence on dual-use technology, cyber risk, biological risk, AI governance, and broader catastrophic-risk transparency. I did not find reliable direct 2024 evidence that Erdoğan adopted or rejected a public AI/cyber/biological-risk framework, published major transparency measures in those areas, or made a visible precautionary decision outside the nuclear/CBRN space.
